## English

- Show separate GPU utilization and VRAM usage bars on each GPU card, using blue and purple with their own labels and values.
- Remember connected servers across application exits. On startup, automatically reconnect previously connected servers only when they have a saved password or use key authentication. Skip password accounts without a saved password; manually disconnected servers remain offline.

## 简体中文

- 每张 GPU 卡片分别显示 GPU 利用率和显存占用进度条，使用蓝色与紫色区分，并显示各自的标签和数值。
- 退出软件时保留服务器连接记录，下次启动仅自动恢复此前已连接且已保存密码或使用密钥认证的服务器。未保存密码的密码账号直接跳过，手动断开的服务器保持未连接。
